citation.title: Oxygen ion impurity in the TEXTOR tokamak boundary plasma observed and analysed by Zeeman spectroscopy
citation.authors: Hey J D, Chu C C, Brezinsek S, Mertens Ph, Unterberg B
citation.venue: J. Phys. B: At. Mol. Opt. Phys.
citation.doi_or_arxiv: unknown (PII S0953-4075(02)31273-2; DOI not stated in supplied text)

topic: Offline Zeeman/Doppler analysis of C2+ and O+ edge lines at TEXTOR. Discusses possible O VI blending in the C VI CXR line used for ion temperature.
own_question: Can oxygen radiation bias CXR-derived ion temperatures? Can C2+ and O+ edge temperatures be identified and modelled with Zeeman spectroscopy?
actual_method_and_evidence: Passive multiplet-1 spectra were recorded by two spectrometers. Paschen–Back profiles were fitted for species temperatures and intensities. Results were compared with a collisional heating model. The authors estimate that unresolved O VI blending could cause up to about 14% underestimate of CXR ion temperature. The supplied text attributes this estimate to earlier work and does not demonstrate it here. All processing was offline and post-shot on TEXTOR, not KSTAR.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Reported CXR/CES impurity temperatures are model-dependent labels; unresolved impurity blending is one cited source of possible bias.
claim_checks.qualification: This is the authors' estimate for the C VI 8-7 line under typical conditions, citing earlier work. It is not measured for KSTAR.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Not relevant. Integration ran from 50 ms to several seconds, offline. No nowcasting, report latency or BES/ECEI inputs.
validation_if_relevant: Fit uncertainty is stated as 5–10% (C2+) and about 20% (O+). There is no held-out validation.
forbidden_inferences: KSTAR CES labels are biased by oxygen
C2+/O+ edge temperatures equal pedestal-top CES temperature or main-ion Ti
evidence for causal nowcasting or real-time capability
the 14% figure is a demonstrated result in this paper
reason_to_include_or_exclude: At most, this source supports a brief caveat that conventional CES labels are not independent truth. It is a different machine, different lines and different question, so optional citation only.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
